thread:
ana: Quick update  small canary for incremental-prefetch finished. Low risk, measurable wins :tada:

peter: Topline?

ana: p50 -6%, p95 -11%, p99 -13% on multi-turn chat benchmark (seq~180). KV RPCs reduced ~38%, token compute ~4% lower for the slice.

ralph: Which routes saw the most benefit?

ana: Long-lived streaming sessions and assistant flows with repeated system context saw biggest tail wins. Stateless single-shot routes unchanged.

bench-bot: Canary: 24h, 5% traffic, env=prod-canary. KV RPC rate -38%, avg latency -8%. Full: https://redwood-internal/bench/reports/1912345678

peter: Any correctness or safety concerns?

ana: Prefetch conservative: only next-prefix keys for active sessions; TTL and versioning in key. Disabled for strict-streaming routes. Ran parity tests + sampled human eval (250 samples)  no regressions.

ops-bot: Auto-fallback guard set: runtime/kv_prefetch/p99_delta > 10% -> rollback.

ralph: Rollout plan?

ana: Ramp 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 72h with automated gates on latency, kv-rpc, and hitrate. Eng-sre to watch first step.

peter: Expose per-route flags for Dedicated?

ana: Yes: kv_prefetch.enabled (bool), kv_prefetch_ttl_ms (int), kv_prefetch_scope (enum). Default enabled, opt-out supported.

ana: I'll drop 2 slides + a short demo in #all-hands by EOD.

sprint-bot: Added ticket RW-4923 to track dashboard tiles and KB update.

ops-bot: Monitoring dashboards updated: runtime/kv_prefetch/hitrate and runtime/kv_prefetch/evict_rate.
